change.capability: GGUF_AOTRITON_PREFILL = False (gfx1100 undefined -> default True, unchanged)
change.policy: _gguf_aotriton_prefill_allowed(backend) consulted in the use_aotriton gate of _run_full_attention_prefill_layer_aotriton; HIPENGINE_GGUF_AOTRITON_PREFILL_ENABLE overrides
change.exactness: same native causal_gqa_gate_bf16 kernel already validated below the 512 threshold; gfx1151 now uses it at all lengths

reason: Measured on the 8060S: the native causal_gqa_gate_bf16 prefill kernel is ~2-5% faster on the serialized full-attention slice at every prefill length 64-2048 with no crossover, and drops the aotriton wrapper overhead (bf16 query conversion, head-major KV copy, stream bridge). AOTriton's tiled flash is tuned for larger GPUs (gfx1100 96 CU / 48 MiB MALL); on the 40-CU 8060S native wins. Routing is exact (same validated kernel), correctness-neutral (KL 0.046 vs 0.034 noise floor), and never slower. gfx1100 keeps the measured 512-crossover policy.
next: P3-FULLATTN: the native causal_gqa_gate_bf16 scan kernel itself (non-tiled) is the remaining prefill-attention lever; laguna_flash_attention_prefill (tiled WMMA) is registered but not wired into the GGUF path.
